<thought>The mass spectrum shows a clear isotopic series spaced by ~1.003 Da with relative intensities matching the binomial distribution expected for carbon (≈11 % for M+1, ≈0.5 % for M+2). No 2 Da spacing or 1:1 ratios characteristic of Cl, Br, or S are present, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
